statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); repo_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); git_branch=""; git_status=""; loc_info=""; if git -C "$current_dir" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_branch="$branch"; if git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks diff --quiet 2>/dev/null && git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git_status="✓"; else git_status="●"; shortstat=$(git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks diff --shortstat 2>/dev/null); staged_stat=$(git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks diff --cached --shortstat 2>/dev/null); ins=$(echo "$shortstat $staged_stat" | grep -o '[0-9]* insertion' | awk '{sum+=$1} END{print sum+0}'); del=$(echo "$shortstat $staged_stat" | grep -o '[0-9]* deletion' | awk '{sum+=$1} END{print sum+0}'); loc_info=$(printf " \033[2m│\033[0m \033[32m+%s\033[0m\033[31m-%s\033[0m" "$ins" "$del"); fi; fi; USAGE=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); CONTEXT_SIZE=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); if [ "$USAGE" != "null" ]; then CURRENT_TOKENS=$(echo "$USAGE" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); PERCENT_USED=$((CURRENT_TOKENS * 100 / CONTEXT_SIZE)); else PERCENT_USED=0; fi; if [ "$PERCENT_USED" -lt 50 ]; then context_color="\033[32m"; context_icon="🟢"; elif [ "$PERCENT_USED" -lt 80 ]; then context_color="\033[33m"; context_icon="🟡"; else context_color="\033[31m"; context_icon="🔴"; fi; context_info=$(printf " \033[2m│\033[0m %s ${context_color}%d%%\033[0m" "$context_icon" "$PERCENT_USED"); if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "\033[36m📁 %s\033[0m \033[2m│\033[0m \033[35m🌿 %s %s\033[0m%s \033[2m│\033[0m \033[95m🤖 %s\033[0m%s" "$repo_name" "$git_branch" "$git_status" "$loc_info" "$model_name" "$context_info"; else printf "\033[36m📁 %s\033[0m \033[2m│\033[0m \033[95m🤖 %s\033[0m%s" "$repo_name" "$model_name" "$context_info"; fi
